last.summary:
Proved, in projects/bzip2/proofs/Bzip2/Proofs/Crc.lean (the only file changed), that the oracle's table-driven CRC and combined CRC equal the spec's, with no sorry. Public theorems, all resting on propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only:
- crc32_eq_spec (data : ByteArray) : (Oracle.Crc.crc32 data).toBitVec = Spec.Crc.crc32 (data.toList.map UInt8.toBitVec)
- combine_eq_spec (combined blockCrc : UInt32) : (Oracle.Crc.combine combined blockCrc).toBitVec = Spec.Crc.combineCrc combined.toBitVec blockCrc.toBitVec
- beyond the two the task names: updateByte_eq_spec (one table lookup is the spec's eight bit steps); update_slice_eq_spec and crc32_slice_eq_spec (the oracle's update/crc32 over any slice data[start, stop), for every start and stop, as (data.toList.drop start).take (stop - start); the previous attempt covered only the default full-array range); streamCrc_eq_spec (foldl of Oracle.Crc.combine from 0 is Spec.Crc.streamCrc).
Proof: each of the 256 table entries equals the spec's byte step on state 0 (decide +kernel); the spec's byte step is xor-linear and splits at the top byte (crcUpdate c b = (c <<< 8) ^^^ crcUpdate 0 (top byte of c ^^^ b)); ByteArray.toList is related to data.data.toList by a short induction on the library's loop, replacing the previous attempt's longer one.
This continues the cancelled attempt's file (it already passed verify): I kept its algebra, simplified bit_linear to a single grind call, removed a redundant have, renamed gethigh to truncate_ushiftRight_append, added the slice theorems and bridge, added section comments, and rewrote the module doc (choices: UInt32/UInt8 related through toBitVec; slice and its clamping are the oracle's).
Checked: (1) every C citation in the module doc read at the cited place: bzlib_private.h:157-160 (BZ_INITIALISE_CRC, 0xffffffffL), 162-165 (BZ_FINALISE_CRC, ~crcVar), 167-172 (BZ_UPDATE_CRC), compress.c:607-608 (combinedCRC rotate-left-1 then xor blockCRC, inside BZ2_compressBlock at compress.c:602), bzlib.c:192 (combinedCRC = 0 in BZ2_bzCompressInit, line 148), bzlib.c:515 (calculatedCombinedCRC = 0 in BZ2_bzDecompressInit, line 492), bzlib.c:832-835 (the decompressor's identical rotate and xor in BZ2_bzDecompress, line 808). I changed the old doc's compress.c:606-608 to 607-608 because line 606 is BZ_FINALISE_CRC of the block CRC, not the combination. (2) Sanity run outside the repo: for a 13-byte array, Oracle.Crc.crc32 d a b equals Spec.Crc.crc32 of (d.toList.drop a).take (b - a) for all a in 0..15, b in 0..17, covering clamped stops and empty slices.
